text:
mike: Quick heads-up — planning a coordinated deploy at 03:00 UTC tonight: runtime v2.3.1 (KV eviction fix) + router header-split change + console schema tweak. Need API and console handoff and a pin strategy.

anna: OK for me. Product window confirmed. What’s the canary plan?

mike: Canary: 5% for first 10m, then 25% for 20m, then full. If latency p50 on runtime increases >20% or error-rate >0.5% we'll pause and rollback.

sarah: Console has a minor schema migration that’s backwards-compatible. Will enable feature flag at canary step 2. Console-oncall will watch dashboards.

console-oncall: I'll be online for the window. Can you post the pin command for the router/api so we can freeze traffic if needed?

mike: Yep — plan is to pin old router variant and route a small steady slice to runtime-v2 during canary. If we need to fast-fail: `redwoodctl pin set router:variant=stable --until=+2h` then scale down runtime v2.3.1 pool.

kevin: Heads-up: deploy-bot will run the schema-migration job after runtime is healthy. We should ensure migration is idempotent and has a dry-run.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy 1799999998 initiated by mike. Wave: runtime-v2.3.1 -> router-header-split -> console-flag. Canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%.

anna: Release notes draft (short): "runtime: v2.3.1 - fixes KV eviction bug reducing latency spikes; router: header-split to route new metadata; console: optional schema flag for improved event indexing." Anyone want to add compliance notes?

sarah: Add: "no DB schema changes, migration is read-only until flag flip" — saves some questions from compliance.

mike: Rollback playbook (short): 1) Pause deploy-bot, 2) `redwoodctl pin set model=runtime:v2.3.0`, 3) Route router back using `redwoodctl route update --variant=stable`, 4) Disable console flag. Keep an incident channel open.

console-oncall: Confirmed. I'll watch console-app error traces and the console metrics dashboard. I'll escalate to oncall if SLO breach.

kevin: I've attached the smoke checks in CI: `smoke/runtime-smoke.sh` (basic generate + KV roundtrip) and `smoke/router-headers.sh` (header passthrough). Deploy-bot will run them between steps.

mike: Perfect. Final ask: API team — please don't roll any major changes to API gateway between 02:30–04:30 UTC.

sarah: Noted. No API gateway pushes in that window from console side.

anna: I'll post the final release note in #release-notes channel at 02:45 UTC and open the post-deploy checklist.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary step 1 starting (5%). Running smoke checks.

mike: Thanks all. We'll take the first 30m to validate. If things look good we'll proceed to 25%. If anyone sees >0.5% errors ping me and console-oncall and tag @mike. :thumbsup:

console-oncall: Listening. If I see anything flaky I'll post graphs + stack traces in thread and call for rollback. :eyes:
